# IntechOpen

> IntechOpen is a global open-access publisher of peer-reviewed scientific journals and books spanning healthcare technology, renewable energy, and interdisciplinary research.

IntechOpen provides a research platform for academic communities to publish and access cutting-edge peer-reviewed content. The platform specializes in emerging technologies including digital medicine, telemedicine, medical devices, and renewable energy systems, with contributions from international researchers and subject matter experts.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed
- open-access
- digital medicine

## Core Platform

- [IntechOpen Homepage](https://www.intechopen.com/): Global open-access publisher of peer-reviewed journals and books

## Healthcare & Digital Medicine

- [Digital Medicine and Healthcare Technology Journal](https://www.intechopen.com/journals/4): IntechOpen journal on Digital Medicine featuring healthcare technology and telemedicine research

## Renewable Energy & Engineering

- [Wind Turbine Generator Technologies](https://www.intechopen.com/chapters/38933): Peer-reviewed chapter on wind turbine generator technologies and renewable energy systems
